attributes.context: This pertains to the 24-PAY OPTION available to teachers, allowing them to choose between twenty (20) or twenty-four (24) pays per year.

extraction_text: The effective date of this option may be delayed if necessitated by installation or operations problems with the changeover of the Board's computer.

attributes.context: This provision is located in Section 3.3 (ASSOCIATION COMMUNICATIONS) under Article 3 (Association Rights).

extraction_text: The Association will have the right to place official notices, circulars, and other nonpolitical materials in Unit I members' mailboxes, in the Board's inter-school mail system, and on the electronic communications systems established by the Board for the purpose of distributing these materials, provided such use does not interfere with the distribution of the materials of the school system.

Any costs resulting from installation and/or maintenance of this equipment will be paid from the funds generated. The disposition of net earnings from such machines shall be determined by the principal and employees in each school.
